mapper.select:
SELECT id, date, time, product_code, product_name, specification, price, category, supplier, applicant, approver, system_assign, freezer_category, freezer_position, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_data
AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{systemAssign}, system_assign) > 0 OR system_assign = #{systemAssign})
AND LOWER(product_name) = LOWER(#{keyword})
AND (product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR specification LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR supplier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR freezer_category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_data (date, time, product_code, product_name, specification, price, category, supplier, applicant, approver, system_assign, freezer_category, freezer_position) VALUES (#{r.date}, #{r.time}, #{r.productCode}, #{r.productName}, #{r.specification}, #{r.price}, #{r.category}, #{r.supplier}, #{r.applicant}, #{r.approver}, #{r.systemAssign}, #{r.freezerCategory}, #{r.freezerPosition})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_data SET approver = #{approver} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_name, freezer_category FROM stock_data WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{name}, freezer_category) > 0 ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_data SET freezer_category = #{value}, updated_at = updated_at WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT freezer_category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM stock_data WHERE freezer_category IS NOT NULL AND freezer_category <> '' GROUP BY freezer_category
